$comment: Pro release policy (v0.2.3+): the release build tracks the Pro repo's
default-branch HEAD — no commit pin. `ref` stays null. Re-packaging an old
host tag therefore bundles whatever Pro main looks like at build time; the
trade-off is deliberate — a pinned extension would lag the host EP contract
(EXTENSION_POINTS_VERSION) and be refused by checkEngineCompatibility at
runtime. A fixed revision is still possible on demand via --pro-ref /
DATAZEN_PRO_REF, which take precedence over this file.
